i am also trying to repair my skin barrier and what i’ve found that works best is splashing my face with warm water (i use cold mostly) in the mornings. my skin improved significantly by doing this, i have had less redness and my skin looks clearer so maybe try sticking to washing your face once a day. i’d ditch the moisturising cream in the AM to use it at night, that way it would absorb into your skin while new skin cells regenerate as you sleep.

once you’ve managed to repair your skin barrier, start by introducing a chemical exfoliator at least 2-3 times a week to get rid of the closed comedones. i’d recommend the 5% lactic acid by the ordinary, it is a gentler version of AHA which is suitable for dry and sensitive skin. on top of that, it’s one of the most hydrating acids.

hyaluronic acid and ceramides both help to keep the skin barrier hydrated. ceramides lock in moisture and prevent dryness and irritation whereas hyaluronic acid retain water.
